blocksize.claim: Level2 grid=13x13 blocks of 4px offset 6; level1 was 12x12 of 5px offset 4; detect block size per level

click_select.claim: Level3: MOUSE click on a small token selects it (turns YELLOW) and freezes agents (gray); click on an agent reactivates the agent pair. Selected token moves with arrows, 1 cell/press

gate_block.claim: Level3 small blue markers at cells (4,2),(3,7),(7,9) block BOTH agents from BOTH sides; SPACE=no-op; maze=4 comps chain, agents in end comps => meet impossible

goal.claim: Two blue agents, one shared input; each press moves each agent 1 block(5px); level completes when both in same block

goal3.claim: Level3: gates block corridors; must move gates out via click-select then open path so agents meet

haz4.claim: Level4: hazard cells are ENTERABLE+FATAL (not blocking) - stepping on resets whole level incl. gate positions; BFS must prune actions whose target is hazard

hazard.claim: Hazard=red checker cells: ENTERABLE+FATAL; stepping on resets whole level (gates too). BFS must PRUNE moves targeting hazard

hud.claim: Rows 0 and 63 black bars shrink ~1 cell per 2 steps = step budget HUD; ignore

markers.claim: Small bright-blue 2x2 markers occupy a maze block and BLOCK movement (not passable, not pushed) - treat as walls

mirror_r.claim: Right-half entity mirrors horizontal; small tokens/gates move UNMIRRORED. Keep meeting cell where both mirror interpretations agree
